text_block_list.text: It cannot be... This is a nightmare...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Hah... Look at me, turning my back on
reality.
Pathetic and weak-willed...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You can do better. I know you can!

text_block_list.text: Do I truly seem so rash?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Then again, you may be right. If I rush
ahead too
eagerly, I'll only trip over my
own feet. I must first
accept my own
inadequacies.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It seems I must chart a new path to my
throne.
Will you help me, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So you still believe in me... even after
this
shameful display.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But you're right, of course. This is not
where my
story ends. It can't be!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф and I spend some time
talking
over our future plans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: My legacy has only just begun!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
